svg.title: Inside a single-shot prompt — technical flow, light theme
svg.desc: Light technical diagram of what happens when a single-shot prompt hits an LLM. System prompt and user message converge into a tokenizer producing token IDs. Tokens populate a context window (purple panel with token-budget bar). Context flows into forward pass panel (purple) showing embed, self-attention, FFN, repeated N times, ending in LM head producing logits. Logits feed sampler. Dashed purple decode-loop arrow returns from sampler back to context window, indicating each new token is appended and the model re-runs. On EOS or max_tokens, output is detokenized and returned. Bottom coral panel lists what is not happening: stateless, bounded context, no tools, probabilistic.
svg.text: What actually happens between request and response
Prefill: all input at once · Decode: one token at a time, KV cache holds the rest
